description_zh: M3 运行时质量、峰/PPI/PRV、IMU、缩放及参考评价的稳定原因码全集。profile_id 与 algorithm_id 是 provenance，明确禁止进入本集合。
description_en: Complete stable reason-code vocabulary for M3 runtime quality, peaks/PPI/PRV, IMU, scaling and reference evaluation. profile_id and algorithm_id are provenance and are explicitly forbidden from this set.

codes.invalid_shape: Array shape violates the profile contract.
codes.invalid_sampling_rate: Sampling rate is absent, non-finite, or non-positive.
codes.channel_order_mismatch: Observed channels do not match the frozen order.
codes.all_nonfinite: A required channel has no finite samples.
codes.excessive_nonfinite: A channel exceeds the one-percent non-finite limit.
codes.short_gap_interpolated: An internal gap no longer than 0.25 seconds was repaired.
codes.boundary_gap: A boundary gap cannot be repaired without extrapolation.
codes.flatline: A required PPG channel is flat for at least one second.
codes.clipping_suspected_heuristic: Repeated extrema suggest edge pile-up; ADC saturation is not claimed.
codes.unit_unknown: Unit metadata is missing or unsupported.
codes.zero_iqr_channel_requires_no_estimate: Robust scaling cannot represent a zero-IQR channel.
codes.DURATION_LT_8S: HR/PPI requires at least eight seconds.
codes.PEAK_COUNT_LT_5: HR/PPI requires at least five peaks.
codes.VALID_PPI_COUNT_LT_4: HR/PPI requires at least four valid PPI.
codes.FREQUENCY_PRV_REQUIRES_CONTIGUOUS_120S: Frequency PRV requires a continuous 120-second valid run.
codes.initialization_pending: The no-precalibration ESKF has not met readiness gates.
codes.prediction_only: The ESKF propagates without an accepted gravity update.
codes.no_estimate: The ESKF readiness, covariance, or prediction-only limit failed.
codes.timestamp_length_mismatch: Timestamp length does not match the sample count. / 时间戳长度与样本数不一致。
codes.timestamp_nonfinite: At least one timestamp is non-finite. / 至少一个时间戳不是有限值。
codes.timestamp_not_strictly_increasing: Timestamps are not strictly increasing. / 时间戳未严格递增。
codes.timestamp_jitter_exceeds_tolerance: Timestamp spacing jitter exceeds the registered tolerance. / 时间戳间隔抖动超过注册容差。
codes.timestamp_chunk_boundary_gap: A streaming chunk boundary contains an unexpected time gap. / 流式分块边界存在异常时间间隙。
codes.unexpected_channel_count: Observed channel count is not allowed by the selected profile. / 实际通道数不符合所选配置。
codes.channel_name_count_mismatch: Channel-name count does not equal array width. / 通道名称数量与数组宽度不一致。
codes.too_short: The signal is shorter than the minimum quality-assessment duration. / 信号短于质量评估最小时长。
codes.filter_pad_too_short: PPG zero-phase filtering cannot satisfy its padding requirement. / PPG 零相位滤波无法满足 padding 要求。
codes.gravity_filter_input_too_short: The LPF gravity comparator cannot satisfy its filter-length requirement. / LPF 重力对照无法满足滤波长度要求。
codes.quality_gate_failed: Preprocessing stopped because the explicit quality gate failed. / 因显式质量门失败而停止预处理。
codes.nonfinite_or_invalid_imu_sample: An IMU sample is non-finite or violates the explicit sample contract. / IMU 样本非有限或违反显式样本合同。
codes.explicit_session_reset_required: Stateful IMU processing requires an explicit session reset before continuing. / 有状态 IMU 处理必须显式重置会话后才能继续。
codes.PEAK_INPUT_INVALID: Peak input is non-finite, flat, or otherwise invalid. / 峰检测输入非有限、平坦或无效。
codes.PEAK_RESULT_INVALID: The upstream PeakResult is invalid and cannot support physiology extraction. / 上游 PeakResult 无效，无法支撑生理提取。
codes.TIME_DOMAIN_PRV_COVERAGE_LT_0P80: Time-domain PRV valid-PPI coverage is below 0.80. / 时域 PRV 的有效 PPI 覆盖率低于 0.80。
codes.OBSERVATION_DURATION_INCONSISTENT: Declared observation duration is inconsistent with the peak/PPI time support. / 声明观测时长与峰/PPI 时间支撑不一致。
codes.NO_MATCHED_PEAKS: No ECG/PPG events matched within the registered tolerance. / 注册容差内没有匹配的 ECG/PPG 事件。
codes.NO_MATCHED_CORRECTED_PEAKS: Legacy explicit label for no matched delay-corrected peaks; retained for audit compatibility. / 无匹配延迟校正峰的旧显式标签，仅为审计兼容保留。
codes.no_valid_channel: Neither RED nor IR produced a valid physiology result. / RED 与 IR 均未产生有效生理结果。
codes.only_red_valid: Only RED produced a valid result and was selected. / 仅 RED 有效并被选择。
codes.only_ir_valid: Only IR produced a valid result and was selected. / 仅 IR 有效并被选择。
codes.sqi_tie_red_order: RED won the deterministic tie-break after equal SQI. / SQI 相同时 RED 按确定性规则胜出。
codes.higher_sqi: The channel with the higher SQI was selected. / 选择 SQI 更高的通道。
codes.amplitude_features_invalid: Fold-amplitude SQI features are unavailable or non-finite. / 折内幅值 SQI 特征不可用或非有限。
codes.amplitude_outlier_training_fold: Amplitude is an outlier relative to training-fold robust statistics. / 幅值相对训练折 robust 统计为离群值。
codes.within_training_fold_range: Amplitude lies within the registered training-fold range. / 幅值位于注册训练折范围内。
codes.raw8_dynamic_view_requires_frozen_traini: The raw8 dynamic view requires an unclipped robust scaler fitted on the training fold. / raw8 动态视图要求仅训练折拟合且不裁剪的 robust scaler。
codes.source_valid_mask_partial: External resampling received a source validity mask with invalid samples; mapped validity must remain explicit. / 外部重采样收到含无效样本的源有效性掩码；映射后的有效性必须显式保留。

status_tokens.valid: Canonical successful state. / 规范成功状态。
status_tokens.repaired: Successful after bounded declared repair. / 经有限且声明的修复后成功。
status_tokens.partial: Partially available result. / 部分可用结果。
status_tokens.invalid: Invalid input or computation state. / 无效输入或计算状态。
status_tokens.insufficient: Insufficient support for an estimate. / 估计支撑不足。
status_tokens.initialization_pending: Stateful estimator is still initializing. / 有状态估计器仍在初始化。
status_tokens.tracking: ESKF readiness gates are satisfied. / ESKF 就绪门已满足。
status_tokens.prediction_only: ESKF is temporarily propagating without an accepted update. / ESKF 暂时仅传播而无接受更新。
status_tokens.no_estimate: No scientifically valid estimate is available. / 没有科学有效估计。

exception_prefixes.profile_mismatch: Registered profile does not match modality, rate, phase mode or algorithm key. / 注册配置与模态、采样率、相位模式或算法键不匹配。
exception_prefixes.unit_unknown: Unit metadata is missing or unsupported. / 单位元数据缺失或不支持。
exception_prefixes.insufficient_length: A causal or zero-phase filter cannot satisfy length requirements. / 因果或零相位滤波无法满足长度要求。
exception_prefixes.unsupported_phase_mode: Requested phase mode is not implemented. / 请求的相位模式未实现。
exception_prefixes.unexpected_fold_registry: The M2 fold authority is not the frozen corrected registry. / M2 折叠权威不是冻结校正注册表。
exception_prefixes.repeat_index_not_found: Requested repeat does not exist. / 请求的 repeat 不存在。
exception_prefixes.fold_index_not_found: Requested fold does not exist. / 请求的 fold 不存在。
exception_prefixes.materialized_fold_invariants_failed: Materialized train/OOF subject invariants failed. / 已物化 train/OOF 受试者不变量失败。
exception_prefixes.future_active_fold_scaler_requires_robus: Future raw8 scaling requires robust and no clipping. / 未来 raw8 缩放要求 robust 且不裁剪。
exception_prefixes.preprocessing_profile_ids_must_be_nonemp: Profile-ID list must be non-empty and unique. / profile ID 列表必须非空且唯一。
exception_prefixes.historical_or_deprecated_profile_cannot_: Historical/deprecated profiles cannot fit a future artifact. / 历史或弃用配置不得拟合未来制品。
exception_prefixes.sample_subject_ids_must_align_with_rows: Sample subjects do not align with matrix rows. / 样本受试者与矩阵行不对齐。
exception_prefixes.feature_names_must_be_unique_and_match_c: Feature names are not unique or do not match columns. / 特征名不唯一或与列不匹配。
exception_prefixes.oof_subject_present_in_fit: An OOF subject was presented to training-only fitting. / OOF 受试者进入了仅训练折拟合。
exception_prefixes.training_roster_mismatch: Observed training roster differs from the materialized M2 fold. / 实际训练名单与已物化 M2 折不同。
exception_prefixes.unexpected_active_m2_protocol: Active M2 protocol is not the frozen corrected OOF protocol. / 活动 M2 协议不是冻结校正 OOF 协议。
exception_prefixes.transit_delay_fit_requires_training_role: Transit delay was requested outside training role. / 在非训练角色请求拟合传导延迟。
exception_prefixes.transit_delay_training_split_id_required: Transit-delay fitting requires a non-empty split ID. / 传导延迟拟合要求非空划分 ID。
exception_prefixes.transit_delay_training_roster_mismatch: Delay-fit subjects differ from the explicit training roster. / 延迟拟合受试者与显式训练名单不一致。
exception_prefixes.no_valid_training_transit_delays: No bounded transit delays support fitting. / 没有生理界内传导延迟可供拟合。
exception_prefixes.evaluation_subject_present_in_delay_trai: Evaluation subject leaks into delay training. / 评价受试者泄漏到延迟训练。
exception_prefixes.transit_delay_sampling_rate_mismatch: Evaluation and delay artifact sampling rates differ. / 评价与延迟制品采样率不一致。
